subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should OpenClaw accept the strict 8 MiB regular-file boundary as the shipped cron quarantine contract, with doctor and manual repair as recovery for previously accepted sidecars?
rationale: The code-level fix is sound, but intentionally changing accepted persisted state and potentially requiring operator action is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept strict boundary
options.body: Land the paired cap and treat the existing doctor warning and manual repair guidance as the supported recovery path.

options.title: Add automated recovery
options.body: Extend doctor with a safe archive or repair operation for oversized and non-regular quarantine targets before landing.

recommendation.title: Accept strict boundary
recommendation.body: Land the paired cap and treat the existing doctor warning and manual repair guidance as the supported recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the quarantine persistence feature and is the strongest available owner of its shipped durability and recovery contract.
